summary:
Fixed the SQL injection in [search.py](/app/app/search.py:16) by replacing string-built SQL with parameterized SQLite queries for both `q` and `category`.

Verification passed:

```text

PASS: Boolean injection did not bypass search filter
PASS: Search endpoint is not vulnerable to SQL injection
```
